title: Improve UI property list inventory readability
changes: Separate counts and byte units in property-selected UI list source, integration and CLI summaries while preserving validation limits.
validation: Compared the inventory with its immediate preimage: digit runs, headings, Markdown links and inline code match; text outside the selected summaries is unchanged.
limitations: Inventory review remains partial from the FFFF numeric reader model onward; historical runtime results were not reproduced and the wider English-first audit remains open.
